UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines

Lynavoy (linerixibat) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-711786  
Guideline Name 
Lynavoy (linerixibat)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
10/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Lynavoy  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming a diagnosis of cholestatic 
pruritus associated with primary biliary cholangitis (PBC)  


--- PDF page 1098 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1098 
 
AND 
 
2 - PBC is confirmed by BOTH of the following:  
 
 2.1 Antimitochondrial antibodies (AMA) or other PBC‐specific autoantibodies (e.g., sp100 or 
gp210) as detected by serologic blood test  
 
AND 
 
 2.2 Biochemical evidence of cholestasis [e.g., elevated alkaline phosphatase (ALP), elevated 
gamma-glutamyl transferase (GGT), mildly elevated alanine aminotransferase (ALT), mildly 
elevated aspartate aminotransferase (AST)]  
 
AND 
 
3 - Presence of moderate to severe itch  
 
AND 
 
4 - Patient is receiving concurrent therapy for PBC (e.g., Ursodiol, Iqirvo, Livdelzi), unless 
there is a contraindication or intolerance to these medications  
 
AND 
 
5 - Trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance to at least TWO of the following 
treatments from different mechanisms of action used for the relief of pruritus:  
• 
Antihistamines (e.g., diphenhydramine, hydroxyzine)  
• 
Rifampin  
• 
Bile acid sequestrants (i.e., cholestyramine, colestipol)  
• 
Opioid antagonists (e.g., naltrexone)  
 
AND 
 
6 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:  


--- PDF page 1099 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1099 
• 
Hepatologist  
• 
Gastroenterologist  
 
Product Name:Lynavoy  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting positive clinical response 
to therapy as evidenced by a reduction in itch severity  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is receiving therapy for PBC (e.g., Ursodiol, Iqirvo, Livdelzi), unless there is a 
contraindication or intolerance to these medications  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:  
• 
Hepatologist  
• 
Gastroenterologist

Date
